stories.headline: GitHub adds policy APIs for repository-wide AI Scan

source.title: Manage AI Scan for repositories using the REST API
source.scope: Reviewed the complete original changelog, organization and repository endpoints, inheritance rules, atomic update behavior, scan activation, roles, credit use, product eligibility and GitHub Enterprise Server exclusion.
source.freshness_reason: Date-only publication is treated as within the latest 24-hour preference; the release provides a current technical governance control.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete original changelog, organization and repository endpoints, inheritance rules, atomic update behavior, scan activation, roles, credit use, product eligibility and GitHub Enterprise Server exclusion.

stories.summary: GitHub’s public preview adds REST controls for enabling AI Scan on repository backlogs at organization and repository levels. Organization policy constrains repository choices, combined pull-request and repository updates fail atomically when blocked, and enabling the setting does not start a scan. Actual scans still require write access, eligible GitHub security products and AI credits.
stories.why_it_matters: Treat enablement and execution as separate controls. Test inherited policy, blocked updates, opt-outs, role permissions and credit consumption in a small organization, then log who may change settings and who may launch scans before automating a wider rollout.
stories.related_coverage: Complete original changelog reviewed, including endpoint paths, inheritance, atomic failure, access roles, credit use and unsupported environments.
stories.image_alt_intent: An organization policy tree governs repository AI Scan settings while separate controls show enablement, scan launch, permissions and credit use.

stories.headline: Agent Skill: approve a ChatGPT Wallet purchase without surrendering control
stories.agent_skills_evidence: The launch, terms, and privacy notice support a reusable six-step review procedure that keeps item, merchant, total, recurrence, funding source, authentication, and receipt matching under explicit user control.

audience_fit.intended_user: Everyday shoppers who can compare an order summary, delivery details, merchant identity, and payment choices before approval.
audience_fit.practical_action: Practice the reusable review sequence on a low-risk purchase: inspect merchant, items, total, address, payment method, and final confirmation.
audience_fit.review_action: Stop and correct any mismatch before approval, then retain the receipt and verify the completed charge independently.
audience_fit.usable_outcome: A repeatable purchase-approval checklist that keeps the user responsible for the final transaction without requiring technical setup.

source.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
source.scope: Reviewed the complete launch, wallet terms and privacy notice covering eligibility, saved cards, payment tokens, merchant responsibility, per-purchase review, biometric approval, disputes and current rollout limits.
source.freshness_reason: Date-only publication is treated as within the latest 24-hour preference; the launch provides a concrete noncoding authorization workflow.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete launch, wallet terms and privacy notice covering eligibility, saved cards, payment tokens, merchant responsibility, per-purchase review, biometric approval, disputes and current rollout limits.

stories.summary: OpenAI’s limited U.S. rollout lets eligible ChatGPT Pro users save a card and approve purchases initiated through compatible dots. Each current purchase requires review and device authentication; the merchant remains the seller, tokenized credentials replace raw card details, and OpenAI’s terms direct disputes to card issuers, merchants or other payment participants.
stories.why_it_matters: Use a five-field approval check before authenticating: item, merchant, total, recurrence and selected card. Reject unclear substitutions or future charges, save the confirmation and merchant receipt, then verify both records match. Never paste card numbers, security codes or verification codes into chat.
stories.related_coverage: Launch, terms and privacy notice reviewed; every current purchase still requires user review and authentication, while future delegation is not treated as available.
stories.image_alt_intent: A purchase approval sheet checks item, merchant, total, recurrence and card before biometric confirmation, with matching wallet and merchant receipts.

skill.name: Bounded wallet purchase approval
skill.audience: Nontechnical ChatGPT users making an eligible Wallet purchase
steps: Review the item, quantity and any substitution.
Confirm the merchant, total price, fees and delivery terms.
Check whether the purchase is one-time or recurring.
Confirm the selected card and reject any request for raw card data in chat.
Approve with device authentication only after all five fields match.
Save the Wallet confirmation and merchant receipt.
skill.output: A user-approved transaction with two retained confirmation records.
skill.validation: The Wallet confirmation and merchant receipt must agree on merchant, amount, item and recurrence; otherwise contact the merchant or card issuer before further action.
